name: Full Stride
source:
Full Stride is a visual novel that details the life of a recent graduate as he (you) turns his luck around with a new job, and discovers what it means to be single again after a rough breakup with his first love.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/AlithiniGame]Patreon[/url]]
